description: This file defines the LeadsViewDetail class, extending ViewDetail, responsible for rendering the detail view of a lead in the SuiteCRM system. It includes logic for displaying a popup form letter and conditionally disabling the convert lead action based on lead status and configuration.

classes.name: LeadsViewDetail
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering the lead detail view, including additional display logic such as popup forms and conditional action disabling.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overridden method that handles rendering the lead detail view, including invoking form letter popup HTML and disabling the convert action if the lead has been converted.
